# Sharks Bar & Grill

> Neighborhood sports bar and grill on S Belcher Rd in Largo. Wings, hamburgers, egg rolls, NFL games, trivia, pool league and Thursday live music.

- Type: Sports Bar
- Address: 1479 S Belcher Rd, Largo, FL 33771, USA
- Phone: (727) 530-1011
- Website: https://vinaynay9.github.io/demos/poker-clubs/florida/sharks-bar-and-grill/

- Google rating: 4.4 from 851 reviews

## About
Sharks Bar & Grill is a sports bar and grill on S Belcher Rd in Largo, the kind of place where local folks stop in and the regulars know each other. One reviewer put it simply: good food, good people.
The menu covers bar favorites like wings, hamburgers, a philly sandwich, fish and chips and egg rolls. There's plenty going on through the week, from trivia and music bingo to a pool league, darts and live music. One more thing from a reviewer: think twice before playing pool with the owner for money.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 851 reviews, and we'd love to see you here.

## Services
- Wings: A reviewer says Monday night wings are a favorite.
- Egg rolls: Egg rolls come in three flavors to choose from.
- Hamburgers, sandwiches and specials: Hamburgers, a philly sandwich, fish and chips and sloppy Joe specials.
- Taco salad and chili: A reviewer said they love the taco salad and the chili.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have live music?
A: Yes. Thursday nights bring live music with an open mic, so bring your instrument if you play.

Q: Can I play pool?
A: Yes. There's a pool league, and darts too.

Q: How late are you open on Friday?
A: On Friday we're open from 11 AM until 1 AM.
